4 |   <foo></foo>
  |    ^^^
fix: Fix the spelling of `<foo>`.
fix: Write a component tag in PascalCase and import the component.
fix: Give a custom element a name with a hyphen, as in `<my-foo>`.

error[VIBE2004]: A `<template>` element needs `v-if`, `v-else-if`, `v-else`, `v-for` or `v-slot`.
  --> template/elements/input.vibe:5:9
5 |   <div><template>loose</template></div>
  |         ^^^^^^^^
fix: Add the directive that the group needs, as in `<template v-if="ok">`.
fix: Replace `<template>` with an element such as `<div>`, or remove it and keep its children.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2004

error[VIBE2005]: Text cannot be a direct child of `<table>`.
  --> template/elements/input.vibe:6:10
6 |   <table>text</table>
  |          ^^^^
fix: Move the text into a cell, as in `<td>`, or into an `<option>`.
fix: Remove the text.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2005

error[VIBE2006]: `<component>` needs a bound `:is` with a component value.
  --> template/elements/input.vibe:7:14
7 |   <component is="Item" />
  |              ^^^^^^^^^
fix: Import the component and bind it, as in `<component :is="Item" />`.
fix: Write the component tag directly, as in `<Item />`, when it never changes.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2006

error[VIBE2009]: The `is` attribute is not supported on `<div>`.
  --> template/elements/input.vibe:8:8
8 |   <div is="x"></div>
  |        ^^^^^^
fix: Write the component tag directly, as in `<Item />`.
fix: Use `<component :is="Item" />` for a component chosen at runtime.
